description: This file defines the 'Manufacturer' entity class for a Java Spring/Hibernate application. It models a manufacturer with properties like id, image, order, associated descriptions, and linked merchant store, including auditing features.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Entity class representing a manufacturer with descriptions, image, order, and linked merchant store, including auditing features.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the manufacturer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the manufacturer.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit information associated with this manufacturer.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this manufacturer.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or path associated with the manufacturer.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or path for the manufacturer.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of descriptions associated with this manufacturer.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this manufacturer.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this manufacturer.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this manufacturer.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the display or sort order for this manufacturer.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order for this manufacturer.
